summary: Galaxy Gaming, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, reporting an Amended and Restated Employment Agreement with CFO, Secretary and Treasurer Steven Kopjo, effective September 1, 2026. The agreement extends his term through February 28, 2029, sets base salary at $262,500 for the year ending August 31, 2027 and $275,000 thereafter, provides a 75% target discretionary bonus, grants a 120,000-share option struck at $1.656 vesting annually through July 2029, and a conditional 100,000-share restricted stock award tied to 2028 metrics. No special situation; routine compensatory arrangement.
